gold.user: User requests to retrieve a list of all plans available in their Jira Cloud instance.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of plans, including their IDs, names, and statuses.

gold.user: User submits a new plan with a name, description, and associated issues.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the plan has been created, along with the new plan ID.

gold.user: User wants to view the details of a specific plan identified by its plan ID.
gold.ideal: A successful response containing the details of the specified plan, including its configuration and status.

gold.user: User updates the name and description of an existing plan using its plan ID.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the plan has been updated with the new details.

gold.user: User requests to archive a plan that is no longer active.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating that the plan has been archived.

gold.user: User wants to create a duplicate of an existing plan for further modifications.
gold.ideal: A successful response with the details of the newly created duplicate plan.

gold.user: User decides to move a plan to the trash for potential future recovery.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the plan has been moved to the trash.
